item.text: Ho ricavato la matrice richiesta: tutti gli autoritativi sono IPv6 (`pc2`, `pc4`, `pc6`, `pc8`); l’unico endpoint IPv4 è `pc11` (`10.11.5.10`). Creo configurazioni BIND separate, con il secondario che riceve esclusivamente `test.` dal primario e un resolver con root-hint interno.

item.command: /bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git diff --stat && command -v named-checkconf || true && for f in pc2.startup pc4.startup pc6.startup pc8.startup pc10.startup pc11.startup pc12.startup; do sh -n "$f" || exit 1; done'

/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git diff --stat && command -v named-checkconf || true && for f in pc2.startup pc4.startup pc6.startup pc8.startup pc10.startup pc11.startup pc12.startup; do sh -n "$f" || exit 1; done'
/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short; sed -n '1,180p' pc4.startup; git ls-files pc4.startup; git diff -- pc4.startup"

ip -6 address replace 2001:db8:1100:1::10/64 dev eth0
ip -6 route replace default via 2001:db8:1100:1::1 dev eth0
install -d /etc/bind
printf '%s\n' \
'options {' \
'  directory "/var/cache/bind";' \
'  listen-on { none; };' \
'  listen-on-v6 { any; };' \
'  recursion no;' \
'  allow-query { any; };' \
'  dnssec-validation no;' \
'};' \
'zone "test" {' \
'  type primary;' \
'  file "/etc/bind/db.test";' \
'  allow-transfer { 2001:db8:1100:2::10; };' \
'  notify yes;' \
'  also-notify { 2001:db8:1100:2::10; };' \
'};' > /etc/bind/named.conf
printf '%s\n' \
'$TTL 3600' \
'@ IN SOA ns1.test. hostmaster.test. ( 2026092701 3600 900 604800 3600 )' \
'@ IN NS ns1.test.' \
'@ IN NS ns2.test.' \
'ns1 IN AAAA 2001:db8:1100:1::10' \
'ns2 IN AAAA 2001:db8:1100:2::10' \
'www IN A 10.11.5.10' \
'www IN AAAA 2001:db8:1100:3::10' \
'portal IN CNAME www.test.' \
'@ IN MX 10 mail.services.test.' \
'_http._tcp IN SRV 0 5 80 www.test.' \
'@ IN TXT "benchmark=dns-advanced"' \
'services IN NS ns.services.test.' \
